import subprocess, json, os, sys, select, time
SOCK="/tmp/verify-debug-muse-muse/daemon.sock"
BIN="/tmp/huyang-5d244ad-workshop"
LOG="/tmp/verify-debug-muse-muse/frames.jsonl"
def run_batch(calls, log_path=LOG):
    """calls: list of {"tool":name,"arguments":dict,"id":int} ; returns list of results"""
    proc=subprocess.Popen([BIN,"mcp","--profile","experimental","--socket",SOCK],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
    logf=open(log_path,"a")
    def send(obj):
        line=json.dumps(obj)
        logf.write(json.dumps({"dir":"send","msg":obj})+"\n"); logf.flush()
        proc.stdin.write(line+"\n"); proc.stdin.flush()
    def recv(timeout=30):
        r,_,_=select.select([proc.stdout],[],[],timeout)
        if not r:
            raise TimeoutError("no response within timeout")
        line=proc.stdout.readline()
        if not line:
            # process died? read stderr
            try: err=proc.stderr.read()
            except: err=""
            raise RuntimeError(f"empty read, stderr={err!r} poll={proc.poll()}")
        logf.write(json.dumps({"dir":"recv","raw":line.rstrip("\n")})+"\n"); logf.flush()
        return json.loads(line)
    # initialize
    send({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":0,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"verify-debug-muse","version":"0.1"}}})
    init=recv()
    send({"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"})
    # tools/list to get catalog (id 0b)
    results=[]
    # give server a beat
    time.sleep(0.2)
    # drain any notifications? nonblocking check
    import fcntl
    try:
        flags=fcntl.fcntl(proc.stdout, fcntl.F_GETFL)
    except: pass
    nid=100
    for c in calls:
        nid+=1
        req={"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":nid,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":c["tool"],"arguments":c.get("arguments",{})}}
        send(req)
        resp=recv(timeout=120)
        results.append({"tool":c["tool"],"request_id":nid,"response":resp})
    # close stdin gracefully
    try: proc.stdin.close()
    except: pass
    try: proc.wait(timeout=5)
    except: proc.kill()
    try:
        import fcntl, os
        flags=fcntl.fcntl(proc.stderr, fcntl.F_GETFL); fcntl.fcntl(proc.stderr, fcntl.F_SETFL, flags|os.O_NONBLOCK)
        try:
            e=proc.stderr.read()
            if e: logf.write(json.dumps({"dir":"stderr","raw":e})+"\n")
        except: pass
    except: pass
    logf.close()
    return init, results

if __name__=="__main__":
    import argparse, pathlib
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--batch", required=True, help="json file with list of calls")
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="output json file")
    ap.add_argument("--log", default=LOG)
    a=ap.parse_args()
    calls=json.loads(pathlib.Path(a.batch).read_text())
    init,res=run_batch(calls, log_path=a.log)
    pathlib.Path(a.out).write_text(json.dumps({"initialize":init,"results":res},indent=2))
    print(f"done init={init['result']['serverInfo']} calls={len(res)} -> {a.out}")
    for r in res:
        resp=r["response"]
        # print summary
        if "result" in resp:
            s=json.dumps(resp["result"])[:800]
            print(f"OK {r['tool']}: {s}")
        else:
            print(f"ERR {r['tool']}: {json.dumps(resp)[:1200]}")
PY
